script:
Zhen Gongzi
When Zhen Gongzi was born, he killed his mother - she died in childbirth. Having no mother from childhood, his father doted on him greatly, satisfying all his demands. The household also had an old butler surnamed Li. When Zhen Gongzi was very young, Li Butler brought back a little girl to raise. Zhen Youcai told Zhen Gongzi that she was an orphan, very pitiful, and told Zhen Gongzi to treat her well.
But Zhen Gongzi didn't think so. He was the only little tyrant in the house - how could he tolerate a second child? So he began making things difficult for this little girl called Zhang Xiaomei in every way. But every time his father saw this, his father would change from his usual kindness and severely scold him. This instead aroused Zhen Gongzi's competitive spirit and rebelliousness, making him even more vicious toward Zhang Xiaomei.
More than ten years passed, and both children grew up. Although Zhen Gongzi no longer bullied Zhang Xiaomei as childishly as when he was young, he never showed her a kind face. A year ago, new guests suddenly moved into the house - supposedly his father's good friend, mystery novelist Wang Writer and his son Wang Guoqing, and later a writer's assistant Ding Assistant. Wang Guoqing was about the same age as Zhen Gongzi and was a poor family's child, so Zhen Gongzi couldn't be bothered with him. Sometimes he even saw Wang Guoqing and Zhang Xiaomei whispering and laughing intimately in some corner of the castle, which made him even more displeased, so he stayed away from this pair of poor lovers.
Also starting about a year ago, his old father's health got worse and worse. He often said he saw hallucinations and such, then began acting crazy, like he had dementia. Zhen Gongzi couldn't care less - in his eyes, Zhen Youcai was just a bank, with no father image.
On December 1st, while wandering around the castle, Zhen Gongzi suddenly heard his old father talking with Wang Writer. His father told Wang Writer that Zhang Xiaomei was actually his illegitimate daughter, and after his death, he wanted to divide the property equally between the two rather than leaving it to just one person. This panicked Zhen Gongzi - it was clearly his family fortune, so why should half of it suddenly be given to that poor woman? And saying that woman had the same noble blood as himself - this was absolutely unacceptable to him. His father said he would publicly announce this news on December 10th. What to do? This really panicked Zhen Gongzi.
Usually feeling that he was the biggest in heaven and earth, Zhen Gongzi was at a loss facing this news. Thinking it over, he could only think that preventing Zhen Youcai from having the chance to announce this news was the only way to save his billions of family fortune from fire and water!
[December 5th Evening]
Just after 10:15 PM, Zhen Gongzi set out for Zhen Youcai's room, preparing to force Zhen Youcai to leave the inheritance to him alone. If that didn't work, Zhen Gongzi was psychologically prepared to kill his old father - as long as he could prevent him from publicly announcing the inheritance distribution, since Wang Writer had no evidence anyway - verbal claims mean nothing. The castle was large, and after walking for quite a while he still hadn't arrived. On the way, Zhen Gongzi suddenly ran into Ding Assistant, who was rushing frantically from the direction of Zhen Youcai's room. The two weren't familiar with each other, so they awkwardly exchanged greetings and went their ways.
At 10:30 PM, Zhen Gongzi arrived at Zhen Youcai's room and quietly slipped in, only to discover a figure hanging from the beam, which nearly made Zhen Gongzi cry out. Looking carefully, he found it really was his old father, who had somehow hanged himself. Although Zhen Gongzi was frightened, he still remembered to take out the forged will and red ink pad he had prepared early on, using his barely cold father's finger to firmly press a fingerprint. Now the inheritance finally belonged entirely to him. Zhen Gongzi turned around wanting to wipe the red ink from Zhen Youcai's hand, but couldn't wipe it off no matter what. Going all out, Zhen Gongzi steeled his heart and bit off Zhen Youcai's thumb in one bite, throwing it out the window. After finishing everything, Zhen Gongzi returned to his room.
